$description: Motion vocabulary. CSS-driven values come from the inline head <style> blocks ported into src/styles/fourmula-head.css; GSAP-driven values come from the 26 verbatim scripts in public/motion/. THOSE SCRIPTS ARE READ-ONLY: they are byte-identical copies of the original site's inline scripts, injected by src/loadSite.js which re-dispatches DOMContentLoaded and load after React mounts.
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.

reducedMotion.detail: public/motion/m27.js is the ONLY script that reads prefers-reduced-motion: it gates background-video autoplay (it also honours navigator.connection.saveData). Nothing else in the site responds to the media query, and there is no prefers-reduced-motion rule in any stylesheet. So for the background-video slot the reducedMotionFallback MIRRORS real behaviour; for every other section it is a design rule this repository prescribes, not observed behaviour. Each section contract states which of the two it is in motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind.

scriptInventory.files: public/motion/m03.js, m06.js..m30.js (m04 and m05 do not exist; the numbering follows the original document's script order).

motion.transition.fast.role: The site's one transition duration: `all .2s` (11 uses) and `opacity .2s` (10 uses) in site-authored rules.

motion.marquee.duration.role: All three CSS marquees run 24s linear infinite: .how__bottom-row (keyframe marquee, translateX 0 -> -100%), .how__column (columnanima, translateY 0 -> -100%) and .hero__slider__row (hero-row, axis switched by --tx/--ty at the 992px breakpoint).

motion.preloader.spin.role: `animation: spinStep 1s steps(8) infinite` on .preloader__loader - an 8-step, not smooth, rotation.

motion.carousel.rotation.role: GSAP rotate:360 on .hero__carousel__in (m17.js) with counter-rotation on .hero__carousel__img (m18.js), both 32s ease none repeat -1.

motion.flash.reveal-in.role: First leg of the flash-word reveal (opacity 0->1 at #F94A00, power2.out) in m23.js and m24.js.

motion.flash.step.role: Colour-step leg of the flash-word reveal (#F94A00 -> #FD7B03).

motion.flash.settle.role: Final leg of the flash-word reveal: to #FFFFFF in m24.js, to var(--fonts-100) in m23.js.

motion.menu.open.role: Menu panel open, power2.out; list items stagger 0.05 over 0.3s (m19.js).

motion.image-anima.min.role: Lower bound of the .is-img-anima-1..5 cross-fade loops (m28.js), repeat -1.

motion.image-anima.max.role: Upper bound of the .is-img-anima-1..5 cross-fade loops (m28.js).

motion.dots.proximity.role: Cursor-proximity opacity response on the footer dots, power2.out (m09.js); m08.js runs the idle wave with steps(2).
